title: Road accident
summary: Keep yourself safe first, then help the injured person until help arrives.
doSteps: Make sure the scene is safe from traffic before you approach.
Call 112, or call the hospital you are heading to.
If they are bleeding, press firmly on the wound with a clean cloth.
Keep them still, warm and talking to you.
If they are not breathing, start chest compressions if you know how.
dontSteps: Do not move them if you think the neck or back is hurt, unless they are in danger where they are.
Do not remove a helmet unless they are not breathing.
Do not give food or drink.
